{{Top|leg}}
'''Stutter-fire''' was tactic created by [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] to counter the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[dovin basal]]s. By firing low powered [[Laser/Legends|laser]] bolts into the dovin basals to over-stress the creatures, the pilots could then fire full power shots to break through the shields.
